visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair tied back in a bun and glowing skin stands centrally against a neutral grey studio backdrop. She wears a white crew-neck t-shirt layered with a black lace-trimmed camisole. She speaks directly to the camera, holding two orange skincare jars. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of a white Sulwhasoo bottle being held. Then, hands are shown applying a clear, viscous liquid onto the back of a hand on a light-colored wooden surface. The texture is shimmering and wet. (3) The woman is back in the studio frame, pumping the white bottle and rubbing her hands together before applying the product to her cheeks and forehead. She smiles with squinted eyes, demonstrating the application process. (4) She holds the white bottle again, using her index finger to point upwards while speaking. White variety-style captions appear at the top. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting her facial features. (5) She holds two orange jars side-by-side to show the difference. She gestures with two fingers. Yellow and white text overlays provide details about the products. (6) A close-up shot shows two dollops of cream on her hand with text labels 'Rich' and 'Light' version in Traditional Chinese. Her movements are smooth and deliberate. (7) Back to the medium shot, she holds one jar and points to her glowing skin. She maintains a friendly, animated facial expression, showing enthusiasm for the results. (8) She demonstrates a skincare 'hack' by mixing the serum from the white bottle with the cream on the back of her hand. Her hands are in clear view, showing the texture change. (9) She holds the mixed product towards the camera, then applies it to her face, showing the instant radiance. The background remains a consistent, uncluttered grey. (10) The final phase features a graphic overlay of product boxes with orange and white colors. Animated orange confetti falls across the screen as she points to the camera, concluding the presentation.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Introduction -> Demonstration -> Benefit -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional review for Sulwhasoo skincare products. It utilizes a personal vlog-style approach where the creator shares her 'empty bottle' experience to build trust with the audience. The intent is to educate viewers on the usage methods of the First Care Activating Serum and the Renewing Cream while highlighting their effectiveness for different skin types and age groups.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of brand logos, detailed explanation of product lines, demonstration of application techniques, and a specific call to action to visit department store counters for samples.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively uses variety-show style text overlays to emphasize key points, making the information dense yet accessible. The creator's visibly glowing skin serves as strong visual proof for the product's efficacy.
